_comment: Exemplars of the e2e tenant's caliban/auto intents (en, fr, ar), set by lib/setup.py with PUT /api/v1/tenants/{t}/intents/{intent}: routers pick them up with the next snapshot, without a config edit or a restart. The intent-to-node mapping (triage -> node/triage@published) is the tenant's node_routes. Synthetic utterances: no names, no identifiers.

triage: I have chest pain since yesterday, where should I go
my child has a fever and a cough, which doctor should we see
my knee is swollen after a fall, I need an appointment
I have a skin rash that itches, can you recommend a clinic
I feel palpitations and short of breath, what should I do
which hospital has an emergency department open now
I am pregnant and need a check-up near me
I need to see a doctor about back pain this week
where should I go for a heart check-up

quel hôpital a des urgences ouvertes maintenant
